US Airport Flights Delayed After Construction Cuts Cable

Flights at several major US airports experienced delays after a construction crew cut a cable. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) had issued a ground stop for flights to major US East Coast airports due to the outage. The cable has since been repaired, and airports are resuming normal operations, according to the US transportation secretary.
